title: Executive head.
bodyText: As used in Article VII of the Interstate Compact on the Placement of Children, the term "executive head" means the governor. The governor may appoint a compact administrator in accordance with the terms of Article VII.
bodyHtml: [§350E-9]  Executive head.  As used in Article VII of the Interstate Compact on the Placement of Children, the term "executive head" means the governor.  The governor may appoint a compact administrator in accordance with the terms of Article VII. [L 1985, c 132, pt of §1]
